transcript.text: Morning, Jess! Two days down, and today makes three. At 12:00 it's 15 minutes of push-ups and squats at home, then send me a selfie after. You in?

Hey Jess! Push-ups and squats at 12:00, 15 minutes at home, so get set up now. Clear a bit of floor space and keep your phone close for the selfie after. You said you'd show up every day, and two in a row says you will. 💪
Hey Jess! It's 12:20, so how did the push-ups and squats go? Send me a selfie after as proof and we'll get today in the books. 💪
sorry crazy day at work, did it at lunch though
No stress, Jess, work days like that happen. Real proof keeps this honest, so can you send me the selfie from after your lunch session? If you snapped one, send it now and today's in the books.
